study.question: After counts and raw relational means recover auxiliary quality only partially, does applying a learned context/target-conditioned nonlinearity before averaging retain useful event-level interactions at fixed representation capacity, and does its benefit depend on auxiliary access to shared item/action embeddings?
study.hypothesis: Raw means cannot distinguish histories with equal first moments but different event-level interactions. A 32-dimensional learned code z_i = Wv*v_i + Wp*(target*key_i) + Wq*[context,target] + b, rectified per event before masked averaging, may recover auxiliary ranking information absent from ReLU(mean(z_i)). Blocking auxiliary gradients at the source embeddings may preserve click quality while the new dense encoder learns to use those embeddings. This is an unverified explanation of the round7 limitation, not an established mechanism.

nearest_work.difference: Archived arXiv:1706.06978v4 primary text, lines75-85 and270-277, inspected. Retain the adapted local-activation path. The new branch pools vector-valued rectified target/context-conditioned event codes; it is not a new attention claim or exact DIN reproduction.

Authorized original arXiv:2508.11565v1 sections3.1-3.2 inspected. It projects events and pools by behavior, then exchanges information using proxies. Here twelve exact-relation means feed residual auxiliary readouts; the experiment isolates rectification timing and source gradients, without iterative proxy attention or broadcasts.

Pinned benchmark source at90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d, lines82-91 and123-170 inspected. Its task-specific linear projections precede masked means. The current affine/ReLU timing contrast tests a different adapted encoder; benchmark masked means and original-paper sum pooling are not conflated.

Source hash612e71551cbf3f9b799424806c4dd46178cc675d93ce557c3de15259d549160d verified. Replace its raw-mean/product residual with a narrower learned code residual. Retain exact counts and membership. Absolute comparisons to round7 also change readout parameterization, so the four new matched cells carry the timing attribution.

study.proposed_difference: Replace the round7 moment residual with factorized affine per-event codes conditioned on supplied context, target, target-field products and historical values. Pool ReLU(z) in the candidate; pool z then apply ReLU in its replacement control. Compute the identical projections on100 events in both cells so the principal matrix shapes and parameter count match. Twelve32-dimensional summaries feed task-specific residual heads using three exposure slots plus three task slots, exact counts and the target. Cross timing with the source gradient gate in a2x2 suite. No new click residual, private vocabulary, loss hook, data pass or label access. The primary click effect can occur indirectly through shared context updates, not through a direct code readout.
predictions: Within each source-gate setting, encode_pool should improve auxiliary mean AUC over pool_encode if nonlinear within-group information is useful. Report cart/fav/buy AUC and Logloss individually; mean auxiliary AUC is secondary, never the selection score.

Blocked cells should reduce the click penalty relative to their shared counterparts. A useful joint outcome would improve auxiliary quality over g2-r0006-exact_blocked and g2-r0007-aligned_blocked without losing click quality relative to incumbent g2-r0004-context_only. No improvement is assumed.

The timing effect should be small on empty/singleton groups and may be larger for long histories. Existing empty/1-16/17-64/>64 history slices are exploratory interaction evidence because history length is only a proxy for relation-group occupancy.

All four cells must have identical parameter counts and paired initialization; their new code branch has no batch state. The two gate values must give identical forward predictions for identical state and timing before optimization.

The timing contrast has equal major projection/reduction shapes but different ReLU tensor lengths (100 versus12). Measure allocated time, wall time, memory and inference; do not infer equal measured cost from matched operators or claim a quality-cost frontier from parameters alone.
falsifiers: If encode_pool does not outperform pool_encode in auxiliary AUC/Logloss at either gate setting, this implementation does not support nonlinear preaggregation information retention. If both beat round7 equally, capacity/readout changes rather than timing remain the explanation.
If the auxiliary timing benefit appears only when item/action gradients are shared and accompanies click deterioration, the proposed protected-source recovery mechanism is not supported.

If click improves without auxiliary improvement, do not attribute it to recovered auxiliary history information; changed context optimization remains plausible. A single seed establishes only a provisional observation.

Any masked-history or target-action dependence, current-label access, incorrect task ordering, unplanned shared embedding alias, stale source gate, nonfinite output/gradient or inherited-initialization mismatch invalidates the affected comparison before scientific interpretation.

If even the better cell misses the incumbent click AUC on full validation, retain the incumbent for selection. A null or negative outcome remains reportable and does not refute DIN, INFNet or all encode-before-pool mechanisms.
alternative_explanations: Click-trained embeddings may lack auxiliary information that a dense encoder cannot recover; round5 private ID capacity recovered more auxiliary quality but added24.26M parameters and substantial time.

ReLU placement changes optimization and feature scale as well as representational distinguishability. A positive contrast alone is not a proof of a sufficient statistic or a general information-theoretic mechanism.
Shared context updates couple auxiliary and click objectives even with item gradients blocked. Parameter aliases must be audited before interpreting gates as ownership of disjoint tables.

Relation groups may be sparse or empty, and missing category/brand IDs are excluded from joins. The suite does not isolate relation membership itself, query conditioning, temporal order or the full32-dimensional width.
New heads are narrower than round7 and have different target/context routes. Cross-round absolute gains cannot isolate timing; only within-suite replacements do.
All historical comparisons are single-seed, and repeated same-seed endpoints are consistency checks. Validation adaptation, user clustering and rare auxiliary positives limit confidence.

BF16 summation, runtime scheduling and pointwise activation counts may yield small cost/numerical differences despite matching principal matrix shapes. No post-pooling optimization that changes execution cost is included in this suite.
